title: Repeat Psychiatric Admissions and the Days Approved under Referrals and Authorizations
content:
Under **Referrals and Authorizations**, repeat admissions add days when a TRICARE Prime request is approved to the network provider after the military clinic's response window has passed.

## Record read

The count of inpatient mental health admission lines of the patient on the patient's TRICARE Prime claim lines dated in the last twelve months.

## Rule

| Inpatient mental health admission lines in the last 12 months | Days added |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 2 |
| exactly 2 | 1 |
| 1 or none | 0 |

Where three or more inpatient mental health admission lines of the patient are dated in the last twelve months, two days are added; where exactly two are, one day is added; otherwise none.
